name: Tumblet · Gremlet #47
description:
A tumbleweed that rolled in from somewhere far away. It's not in a hurry anymore.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Tumblet in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
